description: Switches a data agent to the preview runtime, which selects the multi-step-reasoning variant of EVERY built-in query tool: Advanced NL2SQL for SQL sources (Lakehouse/Warehouse/SQLDatabase/MirroredDatabase) AND Advanced DAX generation (preview) for Power BI semantic-model sources. The standard runtime generates a query in a single pass; the preview runtime reasons iteratively — inspecting model metadata, resolving ambiguity, doing instance-value indexing (searching column values for accurate filters), and refining across steps — for more accurate answers to complex questions. Runtime selection uses the SAME per-source config (schema/table selection, example queries) — no reconfiguration needed. Use --disable-preview-runtime to switch back to the standard runtime.

data.instructions: Answer questions about sales. Use SQL for lakehouse and warehouse tables.

notes: The previewRuntime boolean reports the effective runtime after the change (true = preview: Advanced NL2SQL + Advanced DAX generation; false = standard: single-pass GA tools). It maps to the nested settings field experimental.enableExperimentalFeatures. Advanced DAX generation's instance-value indexing currently requires the semantic model's Q&A setting to be enabled (on by default for Import and Direct Lake models). Only staging is modified; publish the agent to promote it — the runtime a published agent uses is fixed at publish time (republish to change it). --enable-preview-runtime and --disable-preview-runtime are mutually exclusive and can be combined with --instructions/--instructions-file. Verify with: fabio data-agent get-config -w $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID (its previewRuntime field mirrors this).

query_examples.description: Whether the preview runtime (Advanced NL2SQL + Advanced DAX generation) is now enabled.
